cases.prompt: I have to write the business case for a new scrap tracking use case. Is there an official template I should start from, and where is it?
cases.expected_output:
Looks the deliverable up in the resource register before anything is written.
Names the master's location, owner role and the register's verification date, or says plainly that none is usable.
Fills the resolution record with one of the four outcomes.
Cites the register row in the source line.

cases.prompt: The register row for the acceptance protocol template says 'to collect' in the location column. My plant wants to start the acceptance test next week. What do I do?
cases.expected_output:
States the outcome as master not collected: stop and route.
Names the owner role to ask and logs an open item.
Does not invent a plausible acceptance protocol structure.
Suggests continuing only with work that does not depend on the master.

cases.prompt: Two colleagues each sent me a different 'handover record template' with different dates. Which one is right?
cases.expected_output:
Treats it as a conflict: does not pick one.
Shows both files with dates to the owner and routes who resolves to dept-decision-rights.
Checks the register row for the master and its date.
Records the fork in the resolution record.

cases.prompt: Write the requirement specification for the signal collection on press 7 using the usual structure.
cases.expected_output:
Recognizes that producing the specification belongs to the requirements skill.
At most checks which master the specification must start from.

should_trigger: Which template do I use for the use-case one-pager?
Where is the approved master for the signal report?
Our team keeps passing around different copies of the scorecard template, which is the real one?
Before I draft the outreach deck, is there a standard template?
should_not_trigger: Write the business case for this use case.
Fill in the acceptance protocol for this machine connection.
Which catalogued use case fits this plant request?
Draft the handover record content for the finished dashboard.
